name: Aardvark
group: Animals > Mammals > Wild animals on land > Eats mostly insects

features.claim: It has a stout body with a prominently arched back.
features.quote: Its body is stout with a prominently arched back and is sparsely covered with coarse hairs.

features.claim: Its rear legs are longer than its front legs.
features.quote: The limbs are of moderate length, with the rear legs being longer than the forelegs.

features.claim: Its front feet have four toes and its rear feet have five.
features.quote: The front feet have lost the pollex (or 'thumb'), resulting in four toes, while the rear feet have all five toes.

features.claim: Each toe has a large, robust, somewhat flattened shovel-like nail.
features.quote: Each toe bears a large, robust nail which is somewhat flattened and shovel-like, and appears to be intermediate between a claw and a hoof.

features.claim: It is pale yellowish-grey and often stained reddish-brown by soil.
features.quote: The aardvark is pale yellowish-grey in colour and often stained reddish-brown by soil.

features.claim: It has a greatly elongated head on a short, thick neck.
features.quote: The greatly elongated head is set on a short, thick neck, and the end of the snout bears a disc, which houses the nostrils.

features.claim: Its snout looks like an elongated pig snout.
features.quote: The snout resembles an elongated pig snout.

features.claim: Its mouth is small and tubular.
features.quote: The mouth is small and tubular, typical of species that feed on ants and termites.

features.claim: It has a long, thin, snakelike, protruding tongue.
features.quote: The aardvark has a long, thin, snakelike, protruding tongue (as much as 30 centimetres (12 in) long) and elaborate structures supporting a keen sense of smell.

features.claim: Its ears are disproportionately long, about 20 to 25 centimetres.
features.quote: The ears, which are very effective, are disproportionately long, about 20–25 centimetres (7.9–9.8 in) long.

features.claim: Its eyes are small for its head.
features.quote: The eyes are small for its head, and consist only of rods.

second_reading.claim: Its coat is thin, with short hair on the head and tail and longer hair on the legs.
second_reading.quote: Its hair is short on its head and tail; however its legs tend to have longer hair.
